# Assets status — S-P4-07

0.2.0 introduces no new approved assets. It reuses `common/assets/MY/manifest.json`
tokens: `icon.filter`, `icon.check` (goal set), `icon.info` (goal not set),
`icon.close`, `icon.arrow-left-s` (Back), `icon.arrow-right-s` (breadcrumb
separator), `icon.arrow-down-s` (subteam caret), `icon.scope-team` (subteam
button glyph) and the existing search-field glyph.

Member photos in the frames are placeholders: `photoUrl` is optional and the
default is an initials avatar (no photo asset is approved).
